_readme: S740 lane 1 (reads): Copper Mountain College's census pile (reconcile_steps, 9 records). Four of them fail coverage on a course the reissued 2026-2027 catalog prints under a new subject code, which each record's own note names: PSYC 003 and PSYC 005 for the state's PSY 3 and PSY 5, SOCI 002 and SOCI 004 for SOC 2 and SOC 4, COMM 007 for SP 7 (Liberal Arts: Social and Behavioral Sciences 18519, Vocational Nursing 14737 and 20094, Registered Nursing 16657); BIOL 015 for BI 15 and CDEV C1000 for CD 10 are the same case on other records. This prints each course-description page of the reissue that names one of those printed codes or a 'Formerly known as' line for PSY, SOC, SP, CD or BI, line for line, so a session can cite each course_renumbers pair by the catalog's own words. One load. No model call, nothing written.

questions.renumbers: For each of PSYC 003, PSYC 005, SOCI 002, SOCI 004, COMM 007, BIOL 015 and CDEV C1000: the course description's title, units and the former code it prints.
